subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers accept a proof override for this Feishu streaming-card fix, or require a rebased repair with live or sanctioned CardKit proof first?
rationale: The external contributor says they cannot access a live Feishu tenant and DeepSeek streaming setup, while ClawSweeper cannot mark helper console output and mocked tests as sufficient real behavior proof for a Feishu-visible channel change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, resolve the current main conflict, and require redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or maintainer-run proof before merge.

options.title: Override Proof After Verification
options.body: A maintainer with Feishu access can explicitly own the proof gap after verifying the real CardKit path through a sanctioned setup.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, resolve the current main conflict, and require redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or maintainer-run proof before merge.
